subject: ss-medical-oncology
title: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody drug conjugates

steps.tx: Therapeutic monoclonal antibodies exert antitumor effects through direct receptor inhibition and host immune recruitment. **Trastuzumab** is a humanised IgG1 monoclonal antibody binding subdomain IV of HER2, blocking downstream MAPK and PI3K signaling and activating antibody-dependent **cellular cytotoxicity**. By engaging Fc receptors on natural killer cells, trastuzumab stimulates targeted exocytosis of perforins and granzymes to lyse HER2-overexpressing tumour cells.
steps.say: Therapeutic monoclonal antibodies exert antitumor effects through direct receptor inhibition and host immune recruitment. Trastuzumab is a humanised IgG1 monoclonal antibody binding subdomain IV of HER2, blocking downstream MAPK and PI3K signaling and activating antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity. By engaging Fc receptors on natural killer cells, trastuzumab stimulates targeted lysis of tumour cells.

steps.tx: Steric blockade of human epidermal growth factor receptor dimerization prevents lateral cross-activation. **Pertuzumab** binds extracellular domain II of HER2, sterically preventing ligand-dependent **heterodimerization** with HER3 and enhancing HER2 pathway suppression. When combined with trastuzumab, dual epitope blockade provides comprehensive inhibition of HER2 signaling, significantly improving survival in early and metastatic HER2-positive breast carcinoma.

left.title: Trastuzumab Mechanism
points: Inhibits shedding of HER2 extracellular domain

steps.tx: Tumour neovascularization is sustained by circulating endothelial growth factors. **Bevacizumab** is an **anti-VEGF-A** humanised monoclonal antibody that inhibits endothelial cell proliferation, vessel sprouting, and vascular permeability. By sequestering circulating VEGF-A ligands, bevacizumab normalises aberrant tumour vasculature, lowers interstitial fluid pressure to enhance chemotherapy delivery, and suppresses neo-angiogenesis in metastatic colorectal, renal, and non-small cell lung carcinomas.

steps.tx: Epidermal growth factor receptor blockade requires an unmutated downstream signaling cascade. **Cetuximab** and **panitumumab** bind EGFR to block ligand-induced activation, demonstrating efficacy exclusively in RAS and BRAF **wild-type** colorectal carcinomas. In tumours harbouring activating KRAS, NRAS, or BRAF V600E mutations, autonomous downstream MAPK signaling bypasses receptor-level blockade, rendering monoclonal anti-EGFR therapy ineffective while causing unnecessary skin rash and hypomagnesaemia.

rows: EGFR blockade successfully arrests downstream MAPK
Constitutive GTP-bound KRAS drives autonomous growth
Autonomous GTPase signaling bypasses receptor block

steps.tx: Next-generation antibody-drug conjugates deliver potent topoisomerase inhibitors at high stoichiometric ratios. **Trastuzumab deruxtecan** T-DXd is an **antibody-drug conjugate** with a cleavable tetrapeptide linker carrying a topoisomerase I inhibitor payload with a drug-to-antibody ratio of 8. This exceptionally high payload-to-antibody ratio of 8 delivers maximal intracellular cytotoxic concentrations into HER2-expressing solid tumours following receptor-mediated endocytosis and lysosomal protease cleavage.
steps.say: Next-generation antibody-drug conjugates deliver potent topoisomerase inhibitors at high stoichiometric ratios. Trastuzumab deruxtecan T-DXd is an antibody-drug conjugate with a cleavable tetrapeptide linker carrying a topoisomerase I inhibitor payload with a drug-to-antibody ratio of 8. This exceptionally high payload ratio delivers maximal cytotoxic concentrations into HER2-expressing solid tumours.

steps.tx: Diffusible payloads overcome intratumoral target heterogeneity in solid neoplasms. The **bystander effect** of T-DXd occurs when membrane-permeable topoisomerase I payload diffuses across cell membranes to kill adjacent tumour cells lacking **HER2 expression**. Because the released deruxtecan payload is lipophilic and uncharged, it exits antigen-positive cells to eradicate neighbouring antigen-negative clones, explaining superior efficacy across heterogeneous HER2-low malignancies.

left.title: Bystander-Competent ADC (T-DXd)
points: Diffuses into neighbouring antigen-negative tumour cells
Active in heterogeneous and HER2-low cancers

right.title: Non-Bystander ADC (T-DM1)
points: Trapped within lysosomes of target cell only
Ineffective if HER2 target expression is heterogeneous

steps.tx: Trophoblast cell surface antigen 2 provides a broad epithelial target for conjugated cytotoxics. **Sacituzumab govitecan** targets **Trop-2** delivering SN-38 payload via a hydrolysable linker, approved for pretreated metastatic triple-negative and HR+ breast cancers. In the ASCENT and TROPiCS-02 clinical trials, sacituzumab govitecan demonstrated significant improvements in progression-free and overall survival in patients with heavily pretreated metastatic epithelial carcinomas.

steps.tx: Urothelial cell adhesion molecule targeting achieves profound response rates in metastatic disease. **Enfortumab vedotin** targets **Nectin-4**, delivering the microtubule-disrupting monomethyl auristatin E payload, transforming treatment paradigms in advanced urothelial carcinoma. When combined with pembrolizumab in the landmark EV-302 trial, enfortumab vedotin doubled median overall survival compared to standard gemcitabine and platinum chemotherapy, establishing a new first-line global standard of care.
